L73@P3: 1. Scope/适用范围:
L74@P3: The purpose of this document (“Document”) is to specify the specifications of the Lithium ion rechargeable battery
L75@P3: cells with AMPACE Part Number GC-CST-21700B-103L/H (“Product” or “Cell”) to be supplied by AMPACE to
L76@P3: Customer under Customer’s purchase order and AMPACE’s confirmation relevant to the Product. For the avoidance of
L77@P3: doubt, the specifications specified herein do not apply to any Host Device, apparatus, instrument, equipment or
L78@P3: hardware device containing Product or Cell (“Host Device”).
L79@P3: 本产品规格书描述了 AMPACE 依据客户采购订单生产的可充电锂离子电池芯的产品性能指标，AMPACE 产品
L80@P3: 代码号 GC-CST-21700B-103L/H (“产品” 或 “电芯”)。为避免疑问，本产品规格书不适用于任何包含该产品
L81@P3: 或电芯的主机设备、仪器、仪表、器件、硬件设备等（“主机”）。
L82@P3: For civil use only, and shall not be used for weapon or military purpose.
L83@P3: 仅供民用，不得用于武器或者军事目的。
L84@P3: 2. Model Name/型号：
L85@P3: JP50P1
L86@P3: 3. Standard Environmental Test Conditions/标准环境测试条件:
L87@P3: 3.1 Unless otherwise specified, all tests stated in this Product Specification are conducted at below conditions:除非特别
L88@P3: 指定，本产品规格书所有的测试遵循如下条件：
L89@P3: Temperature/温度: 25±2℃ (“Temperature Condition”/“温度条件”)
L90@P3: Humidity/湿度: 65±20% RH (“Humidity Condition”/“湿度条件”)
L91@P3: 3.2 In this product specification, all items marked with “*” apply only to products that are unused and within 30 days from
L92@P3: the manufacturing date at AMPACE. If the product has been used by the customer or stored for more than 30 days, it may
L93@P3: exhibit performance below the standard specifications. The customer agrees and accepts that the product does not constitute
L94@P3: a non-conformance to the specifications
L95@P3: 在本产品规格书中，所有标有“*”的项目是指仅适用于“未使用的且从AMPACE制造日起30天内的产品”。如果产
L96@P3: 品已被客户使用或存储时间超过30天，可能表现出低于标准规格，客户同意并接受产品不构成不符合规格。

L267@P7: No. Items/项目 Test Method and Condition/测试方法和条件 Criteria/判定标准
L268@P7: 5.2.1
L269@P7: Drop Test
L270@P7: 跌落测试
L271@P7: Each fully charged Cell is dropped three times from a height of 1.0m onto
L272@P7: a concrete floor. The Cells or batteries are dropped so as to obtain impacts
L273@P7: in random orientations.
L274@P7: 将满充电后的电芯从 1.0m 高度自由跌落至水泥地面上 3 次。电芯跌
L275@P7: 落时应保证在每个随机方向均受到冲击。
L276@P7: No fire
L277@P7: /不起火
L278@P7: No explosion
L279@P7: /不爆炸
L280@P7: 5.2.2
L281@P7: Vibration
L282@P7: Test
L283@P7: 振动测试
L284@P7: A Cell is to be subjected to simple harmonic motion with amplitude of
L285@P7: 0.8mm (0.03inch) [1.6mm (0.06inch) total maximum excursion], The
L286@P7: frequency is to be varied at the rate of 1 hertz per minute between10 and55
L287@P7: hertz, and return in not less than 90 or more than 100 minutes. The Cell is
L288@P7: to be tested in three mutually perpendicular directions. For a Cell that has
L289@P7: only two axes of symmetry, the Cell is to be tested perpendicular to each
L290@P7: axis.
L291@P7: 在电芯上施加振幅为 0.8mm 的简谐振动，最大行程为 1.6mm。振动
L292@P7: 频率从 10Hz~55Hz 间以 1Hz/min 的速率变化。频率变化范围为从
L293@P7: 10Hz 升至 55Hz，然后再从 55Hz 返回到 10Hz 。每个安装位置（振
L294@P7: 动方向）上的振动应在 90±5min 内完成。按照相互垂直的三个方向
L295@P7: 进行振动试验。对于只有 2 个对称轴的电芯沿着轴向和径向两个方向
L296@P7: 进行振动试验。
L297@P7: No fire
L298@P7: /不起火
L299@P7: No explosion
L300@P7: /不爆炸
L301@P7: 5.2.3
L302@P7: Shock Test
L303@P7: 冲击测试
L304@P7: The Cell is to be secured to the testing machine by means of a rigid mount
L305@P7: which supports all mounting surfaces of the Cell. Each Cell shall be
L306@P7: subjected to a total of three shocks of equal magnitude. The shocks are to
L307@P7: be applied in each of three mutually perpendicular directions unless it has
L308@P7: only two axes of symmetry in which case only two directions shall be
L309@P7: tested. Each shock is to be applied in a direction normal to the face of the
L310@P7: Cell. For each shock the Cell is to be accelerated in such a manner that
L311@P7: during the initial 3milliseconds the minimum average acceleration is 75g
L312@P7: (where g is the local acceleration due to gravity).The peak acceleration
L313@P7: shall be between 125and175g.Cells shall be tested at a temperature of
L314@P7: 20±5°C (68±9°F).
L315@P7: 电芯通过刚性的方法固定在测试机器上，该方法应能支撑电芯。所有
L316@P7: 固定面。电芯要承受等值的三次冲击。冲击应在相互垂直的三个方向
L317@P7: 上实施，至少有一个方向应当垂直于水平面。电芯承受的加速度应满
L318@P7: 足如下方式：在最初的 3ms 内，最小平均加速度为 75g，峰值加速度
L319@P7: 在 125g 和 175g 之间。电芯应在 20±5°C 的环境温度下进行测试。.
